Ticket T-0288: OpenAPI contract for the Command Center shared data layer
R-066 Command Center views read one shared data layer with real labelled numbers only.
  - Hive and Project Cockpit import the same board data module; a unit test asserts both views resolve identical values for projects, agents live, and needs-you counts.
  - Every number rendered in Command Center views has a visible label and a hover explanation citing its source field; numbers without a trusted source are omitted from the DOM.
  - Board accuracy tests from S4 extend to Hive stat strip and Cockpit counters; CI fails with exit non-zero when a displayed figure disagrees with the ledger by more than one ticket or $0.01 spend.
Use the dependency versions in package.json; do not assume other major versions.
Watch out for (background from past lessons; it does not change the task, the files or the outputs):
- Generated mock must satisfy its own contract tests; contract tickets should emit OpenAPI. [contracts, mock-drift, openapi]
- Every build ticket must pass the project typecheck and lint (and build when cheap) before it is done; a failure goes back to the worker with the errors. [lint, quality-gate, tests-not-run, typecheck]
- Every ticket needs a test-run step against local Supabase/npm before it counts as done. [database, tests-not-run, verification]
Work only on the files you own; report the ticket id.

Ticket T-0291: Classic tab wrapper that holds the existing Swarm Watch views
R-067 Everything Swarm Watch has today stays.
  - Current Swarm Watch views move under a Classic tab; no existing route is removed from the router.
  - A Playwright test requests each pre-upgrade Swarm Watch path and asserts HTTP 200 and a non-empty main landmark.
  - Build progress, deploy tracking, and owner action panels from S4 still render under Classic with the same data contracts.
Acceptance (each line has a tag; the ticket is done only when every line is met):
- AC1: Current Swarm Watch views render under a Classic tab
- AC2: No existing route is removed from the router
This ticket owns no test file: do not write tests, test blocks or import.meta.vitest in your source files, and do not run the test runner. Prove your work with the type check (and lint) and by reading your code against each line. A line that needs a test belongs to the test ticket; a reviewer checks the rest against your code.
Use the dependency versions in package.json; do not assume other major versions.
Watch out for (background from past lessons; it does not change the task, the files or the outputs):
- Check that the tools a landing step depends on actually exist before doing any real work, and always show what came back, even when that is nothing. [build, manifest, path-safety]
- A feature that talks to another machine is not done until a test runs it against a real host; stub transports prove only the scheduling around it. [build, sandbox, ssh-remote, tool]
- Derive the repo from the git remote instead of trusting a stale flag, and explain a redirect as a possible rename. [build, manifest]
Work only on the files you own; report the ticket id.
acceptance: Current Swarm Watch views render under a Classic tab
No existing route is removed from the router

Ticket T-0307: Glitch effect wrapper with duration, concurrency and reduced-motion limits
R-075 Signature glitch style uses PowerGlitch within strict limits.
  - Glitch-in on first load and on Hive→Cockpit switches; brain flickers on event bursts; hover glitch on project names, ticket ids, and robot heads; CountUp updates get a brief glitch; needs-you chips glitch once then stay still; failures and rate limits use stronger red or amber glitch; section headings glitch reveal on scroll into view.
  - Each burst lasts under 400 ms, never loops continuously, never runs on text actively updating, and at most 3 glitches run at once; all effects disable when `prefers-reduced-motion` is set.
  - `npm test -- tests/command-center-glitch-limits.test.mjs` exits 0 and asserts burst duration, concurrency cap, and reduced-motion off state.

- AC1: Each burst lasts under 400 ms and at most 3 glitches run at once
- AC2: All effects disable under prefers-reduced-motion
